title: Introduction and overview — Nagato-class Battleship
description: Introduction and overview of the Nagato-class Battleship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. Japan's Nagato class — two ships — were the first battleships with 16.1-inch guns and, at 26.5 knots, the fastest battleships of their day. Nagato was Admiral Yamamoto's flagship at Pearl Harbor. Mutsu exploded in 1943; Nagato survived to be sunk as a Bikini atomic-bomb target in 1946. Baseline facts: Japanese battleship; 2 built; 16.1-inch guns; Yamamoto's Pearl Harbor flagship..
